description: T1 item 9 (Testbenches shipped). cold_start is local_only: it needs the pinned combined IHP-Open-PDK checkout, ngspice >= 43 and a built psp103.osdi (sim/README.md), none of which a GitHub runner has. It runs sim/smoke/run_smoke.sh, which appends one sim/smoke/records/*.json per run. The five PVT-grid benches (issue #30, decision record 0011) are inventoried but not cold-started here: their grids go to the batch fleet through klt sim, which a GitHub runner cannot reach either. sim/closed-loop-psrr-op (issue #93) is inventoried on the same terms and is likewise not cold-started: it is a shipped testbench, but it grades nothing -- no limits, no spec_row tag, no manifest citation -- so it appears here and nowhere else in this manifest. Each bench contributes its deck template and its committed klt sim request -- what the bench IS; bench.json and sim/grid-run.sh are runner plumbing and are not inventoried, the same convention that leaves the per-bench run.sh out. See attest/README.md.
